paragraphs: The University of Bradford is a public research university in Bradford, West Yorkshire. Founded in 1966, the university is best known for the School of Management (Triple Crown — AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA — top 1% globally), Faculty of Engineering and Informatics, the world-renowned Department of Peace Studies and International Development (the first in the world), Pharmacy, and Nursing. Bradford is a small, focused city-centre campus, one of the most ethnically diverse universities in the UK.
International students enter via Oxford International pathway programmes — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead into a Bradford Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: University of Bradford — государственный исследовательский университет в Брэдфорде (West Yorkshire). Основан в 1966 году. Известен School of Management (Triple Crown — AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA — топ-1% мира), факультетом Engineering and Informatics, всемирно известным Department of Peace Studies (первый в мире), фармацией и сестринским делом. Небольшой city-centre кампус — один из самых этнически разнообразных университетов UK.
Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Bradford.
